thresholds.source: Espressif ESP32-S3 datasheet (recommended VDD 3.0-3.6V, VIH=0.75*VDD, VIL=0.25*VDD): https://documentation.espressif.com/esp32-s3_datasheet_en.html
ME6211 vendor page (fanhaiic.com/h-nd-3323.html: 70 dB PSRR @1kHz, Iq 40uA, 100mV@100mA) + BOM '100 mV @300 mA' (conflict noted)

notes: If the vendor web figure (100 mV @100 mA => ~1 ohm) is right, at Vin=3.4 V the LDO falls out of regulation above ~100 mA. The real system peak is ESP32-S3 radio + OLED (order 100-370 mA, short bursts), so this only matters near end-of-discharge. Dropout must be measured on hardware; BOM and vendor web text conflict.
